message.content:
{
  "roles": [
    "trader",
    "consumer"
  ],
  "if": [
    "the consumer is not yet bound by the contract or offer",
    "there is any extra payment in addition to the remuneration agreed upon for the trader’s main contractual obligation",
    "the trader has not obtained the consumer’s express consent",
    "the trader has inferred consent by using default options which the consumer is required to reject in order to avoid the additional payment"
  ],
  "then": "the trader shall seek the express consent of the consumer to any extra payment in addition to the remuneration agreed upon for the trader’s main contractual obligation; the consumer shall be entitled to reimbursement of this payment",
  "exceptions": []
}
